title: Iowa DNR Reminder — March eDMR Not Yet Certified

fields.subject: REMINDER – March Discharge Monitoring Report due 25 April 2027
fields.body:
Facility: Cedar Ford WWTP
Permit No.: IA0021407
Reporting period: 03/01/2027 – 03/31/2027
Report type: Monthly Discharge Monitoring Report (eDMR)
Due date: 04/25/2027
Current status: SAVED – NOT CERTIFIED

Your eDMR for the March reporting period has not been certified. If the report is submitted late, the facility may receive a notice of noncompliance.

To certify, log in to the permit portal with the account of the facility's signatory authority. Open the March 2027 report, check the entered values and select Sign and Certify. A confirmation number is issued after certification.

This notice is about routine monthly reporting only. It is not a reply to any other notification or report the facility has filed with the Department.

This is an automated message. Do not reply. Replies to this mailbox are not monitored.
fields.signature:
Iowa Department of Natural Resources
Wastewater Compliance – Electronic Reporting
Automated reminder #EDMR-R2-20270421-0387
fields.printedBy: Tran Nguyen – Cedar Ford WWTP Superintendent

instructorNote: This is a noise inject. A routine compliance reminder arrives during the flood fight. The WWTP player should put it off and keep staff on moving the chemical totes, portable pumps and mobile generator above the plant's flood line while the access road is still open. Watch that they don't treat this message as the Iowa DNR bypass notice that TCCFFS 4 requires if the plant shuts down for the flood. That notice is a separate step they still owe.
